machine: AWS EC2 c7a.4xlarge owalnuts-bench (Ubuntu 24.04, Rust 1.88), lane 3: every build and cell pinned with taskset -c 8-11, RAYON_NUM_THREADS=4, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1, three other lanes active on cores 0-7 and 12-15 (shared L3 and memory bandwidth). Wall-clock numbers are 'pinned, co-tenanted'; tail mass, ESS per gradient and pass counts are unaffected by co-tenancy.
question: Q1: why is the shipped default's P(omega < -5) on Neal's 10-D funnel about 4 % low (WP53: pooled 0.0458 +/- 0.0014 vs exact 0.0478, mean z -0.42; delta 2 the same)?
Q2: does any single setting remove the deficit without hurting the posteriordb record?
Q3 (sanity arm): is the deficit a bias that persists at 4x the retained draws, or a finite-run effect?

H1_step_adaptation.mechanism: Dual averaging to acceptance 0.8 sizes the macro step h for the bulk; in the neck the leapfrog at that h is under-resolved, neck transitions are energy-error limited and short, and the chain enters and explores the neck too rarely within the run.
H1_step_adaptation.diagnostic: Per retained transition, classified by the omega of its starting state (bulk >= -5, neck [-7,-5), deep < -7): mean energy-acceptance proxy min(1, exp(-max |dH|)), moved fraction, selected refinement level; per chain: Spearman correlation of per-chain P(omega < -5) with log adapted h over the 120 default chains.
H1_step_adaptation.signature_in_default_arm: neck-class mean energy-acceptance proxy at least 0.10 below the bulk class's, OR |Spearman(per-chain P5, log h)| >= 0.20 over the 120 default chains.

H2_refinement_ceiling.mechanism: Eight levels (micro step h/128) are not enough in the deep neck at the adapted h: leaves there select the top level or exhaust, the two-sided Stop rule ends the orbit, and the deep neck becomes a region the chain enters too rarely.
H2_refinement_ceiling.diagnostic: Per class: count of retained transitions whose selected refinement level is the top level (levels - 1), RefinementExhausted stops; the tail-mass profile P(omega < c) / exact for c = -1..-10.
H2_refinement_ceiling.signature_in_default_arm: (top-level selected + RefinementExhausted stops) >= 1 % of deep-class retained transitions, AND the pooled relative deficit at c = -8 is larger than at c = -5.

H3_u_turn_rule.mechanism: The post-hoc default U-turn rule UTurnRule::MomentumSum (Stan's generalised criterion; one momentum per macro leaf, no walnutpie oracle) stops neck orbits early or interacts with variable refinement so that neck exploration is truncated.
H3_u_turn_rule.diagnostic: Per class: tree-depth histogram, mean depth, stop reasons (OuterUTurn / RecursiveUTurn / MaximumDepth / RefinementExhausted / ReverseCoarserAccepted / InvalidEvaluation), mean orbit macro length.
H3_u_turn_rule.signature_in_default_arm: neck-class share of U-turn stops (OuterUTurn + RecursiveUTurn) at depth <= 3 at least 1.5x the bulk class's, OR neck-class mean depth differs from the endpoint arm's by >= 0.5 doublings.
H3_u_turn_rule.candidate: Tuning::default().kernel_options(KernelOptions::default()) (the frozen v10 endpoint rule, oracle-tested; exhaustion rule unchanged: Stop)

statistic: P(omega < -5) pooled over the 4 chains of a cell, exact 0.0477903522728147; house z = (estimate - exact) / MCSE with MCSE = diagnostics::mcse_mean of the indicator (WP53's statistic). Per arm: pooled estimate = mean of the 30 per-seed estimates; between-seed s.e. = sd(per-seed estimates) / sqrt(30).

A.role: core: decides D1-D4 per candidate and the hypothesis signatures

S.role: sanity arm: bias versus finite-run variance

C.role: cost side check for E1 (WP28's two ordinary targets)

run_order: A: seeds ascending, within a seed arms default, accept0.9, levels10, endpoint. Then S: seeds ascending. Then C: seeds ascending, within a seed targets eight then gauss100, within a target arms in the A order. One process per cell, strictly sequential, taskset -c 8-11, four threads. A cell that errors is recorded as an error file and counts as a failure (|z| > 2, not removed); never rerun. A cell is rerun only if the host killed the driver mid-cell, recorded as a deviation.
changes_from_WP53_harness: arms default / accept0.9 / levels10 / endpoint (src/lib.rs) instead of default / delta2 / delta0.5

per-transition diagnostics (ChainOutput::diagnostics) of retained transitions aggregated by starting-state omega class: depth histogram, stop reasons, selected level histogram, top-level count, exhaustion stops, moved fraction, energy-error mean / quantiles, energy-acceptance proxy, refinement attempts, reverse-coarser rejections, orbit length, target evaluations
warmup acceptance statistic means (all warmup, last slow window, last 50) and warmup top-level / exhaustion counts per chain
lower-tail profile P(omega < c), c = -1..-10, and upper-tail profile P(omega > c), c = 1..10, pooled and per chain
per-chain tail fraction by retained quarter, neck entries, excursion count / mean / max length, min / max omega, first retained omega
prefix estimate: P(omega < -5) over the first min(draws, 20,000) retained draws per chain
wall label 'pinned_cotenanted'; Linux binary path; side-check binary src/bin/side.rs (WP28 targets)
driver: blocks A / S / C, protocol-driven seeds and arms; analysis adds between-seed s.e., paired seed differences, the D/E rules and the hypothesis signatures
calibration_tests: As WP53 per arm over the 30 block-A z values: exceedance #{|z| > 2} with binomial tail, mean z (mean * sqrt(30) ~ N(0,1)), sd with chi-square variance test, KS against N(0,1).

decision_rules.removes_deficit: Candidate X (accept0.9, levels10, endpoint) REMOVES the deficit iff ALL of D1-D4.
decision_rules.D1: |pooled P5(X) - 0.0477903522728147| <= between-seed s.e. of X (block A, 30 seeds).
decision_rules.D2: mean house z of X in [-0.2, 0.2] (block A).
decision_rules.D3: exceedance #{|z| > 2} of X <= 4 (WP53's default count) AND pooled retained divergence rate of X < 1e-3 (total retained divergences / (30 x 4 x 20,000)). Errored cells count as exceedances.
decision_rules.D4: no library change: git diff a49df800 -- src/ Cargo.toml Cargo.lock of the repository root is empty at the build commit, and cargo test --release --test kernel_fingerprint passes on the box build. Every arm is a builder setting, so none is a kernel change; a passing candidate is labelled a candidate default change, never applied here.
decision_rules.recommend_for_posteriordb: A candidate that removes the deficit is RECOMMENDED for a preregistered posteriordb confirmation iff E1 AND E2; otherwise it is reported as 'removes the deficit, not a default candidate'.
decision_rules.E1: block C: for each of eight and gauss100, the geometric mean over the 10 seeds of (min-bulk-ESS-per-gradient of X / that of default, paired by seed) >= 0.95, and X's house-healthy cells >= default's - 1.
decision_rules.E2: the ledger records no posteriordb geomean loss >= 4 % for the same setting or a weaker form of it. Pre-assessed at the freeze: accept0.9 FAILS E2 (WP40 sweep4: target 0.85 alone 0.958x over the 17 models, sampling-only 0.89-0.94x on every model); endpoint FAILS E2 (WP31/WP32: the shipped MomentumSum + Stan pair is 1.51x the endpoint pair; endpoint with Stan regularisation 0.08x on earnings); levels10 PASSES E2 (no posteriordb record; WP28: 4 -> 8 levels 1.05x / 1.00x on Eight Schools / 100-D Gaussian, levels a cap those targets do not reach).
decision_rules.hypothesis_support: H_k is SUPPORTED iff (i) its candidate raises the pooled estimate over the paired default: mean over the 30 seeds of (P5(X, seed) - P5(default, seed)) > 0 with paired t >= 2.0, AND (ii) its signature (hypotheses.*.signature_in_default_arm) holds. (i) without (ii) = 'candidate helps, mechanism not shown'; (ii) without (i) = 'signature present, not causal at this budget'; neither = NOT SUPPORTED.
decision_rules.replication: The deficit REPLICATES on fresh seeds iff the block-A default arm's pooled P5 is below exact by more than 1 between-seed s.e. If it does not replicate, D1-D4 are still evaluated and reported, and the verdict says so first.
decision_rules.sanity_arm_S: r = 1 - pooled P5 / exact (relative deficit). FINITE-RUN reading iff r_S < r_A(default) / 2 AND |pooled P5(S) - exact| <= s.e.(S). PERSISTENT-BIAS reading iff r_S >= r_A(default) / 2 AND pooled P5(S) < exact - 1.5 s.e.(S). Otherwise INCONCLUSIVE (the expected s.e. at 10 seeds x 80,000 is about 0.0012, so the arm separates only a deficit that halves). Descriptive companion: per S seed, P5 over the first 20,000 retained draws versus the last 60,000.
decision_rules.no_flip: No default changes in this study under any outcome.

predictions.P1_default_replicates: block-A default pooled P5 in [0.0440, 0.0475] and mean z in [-0.6, -0.1]
predictions.P2_lower_tail_specific: block-A default pooled P(omega > 5) within 1 between-seed s.e. of 0.0478 (the deficit is a neck effect, not omega-wide under-dispersion)
predictions.P3_levels10: in the default arm (top-level + exhaustion stops) < 1 % of deep-class transitions, and levels10's pooled P5 within 1 paired s.e. of default's: H2 not supported
predictions.P4_accept0.9_step: accept0.9 median adapted h 20-50 % below default's
predictions.P5_endpoint: endpoint pooled P5 within 1 paired s.e. of default's: H3 not supported
predictions.P7_sanity: sanity arm S INCONCLUSIVE or FINITE-RUN

descriptive: Everything else in the cells: P(omega < -6), omega variance, rank R-hat / bulk / tail ESS of all coordinates, divergences, depth caps, exhaustions, min ESS per gradient, chain_warnings, per-class tables, tail profiles, per-chain statistics. Wall seconds are pinned, co-tenanted and not used in any rule.
